intro: Six chicken nuggets are an estimated 280 kcal. The calories come from the minced chicken mix, flour coating and frying oil.
diet: Yes, if you watch the portion. Six pieces is still moderate, but the protein isn't as high as plain chicken because of the flour and other ingredients. The usual problem is eating straight from the pack without counting. Put your portion on a plate and add some veg or a little rice to make it a complete meal.
tips: Cook them in an air fryer or oven instead of deep-frying.
Put 6 pieces on a plate, and keep the rest of the pack in the fridge.
Pair with boiled veg or cucumber to feel fuller without adding many calories.

swap.name: Grilled chicken breast cubes (100 g)
swap.why: Almost double the protein with fewer calories. Kids like it too if you cut it small and marinate it.

faq.q: Are chicken nuggets okay for kids every day?
faq.a: Once in a while is okay. For daily meals, it's better to rotate with home-cooked chicken, fish or eggs for a more balanced diet.

faq.q: How long do I cook nuggets in the air fryer?
faq.a: Usually 180°C for 8 to 10 minutes. Flip halfway so they crisp evenly. Check the instructions on the pack.

faq.q: Can I make my own nuggets at home?
faq.a: Yes. Blend chicken breast with a bit of garlic and pepper, shape, coat with breadcrumbs, then bake or air fry. Freeze them for stock.
